Marker saying a Knowledge Graph fact came from Entity Authority feedback. No fields.
Stores the bug ID tied to a legal request behind a Knowledge Graph fact.
Stores internal Livegraph processing metadata on a triple's provenance: writer ID, triangulation keys, direct-write record IDs and a weak-data flag.
Stores a bitmap of LLM data-usage restrictions on Knowledge Graph data.
Stores licensed-media policy fields for Knowledge Graph data: allowed clients and regions, attribution, linkback and share-alike requirements.
Stores data-governance policy for a Knowledge Graph triple: availability window, legal regions, and LLM, LMS, RWJ and UMP policy sub-fields.
Stores public attribution URLs and last-verified date certifying a Knowledge Graph fact as public information.
Stores eligible surfaces for Real World Journey data policy.
Records how a sensitive personal-info fact was certified: authority feedback, legal request or public information.
Stores the source of a Knowledge Graph triple: dataset, process, creator, source URL and doc IDs, timestamps, access requirements, triangulation flag and policy metadata.
Stores UMP policy fields: availability start and end times and allowed regions.
Stores features used to rank podcast recommendations: listening history, affinity and similarity scores, safe-search scores, impressions, popularity, language match and feed PageRank.
Stores a language code and score for a user's podcast listening language.
Stores a telephone number split into country code, area code, number sections, national prefix and extension.
Describes the document info stored in Teragoogle docshards: the document itself, sections, attachments, average term weight, doc IDs and original encoding.
why: Document content and term weight storage for indexing

summary: Stores miscellaneous named attachments (name, value, options) added to the dynamic repository the docservers build. They override attachments created by parsing the document.
why: Indexing-side document attachments that override parsed ones.

summary: Stores extra sections (field names, tokens) added to the dynamic repository the docservers build; their contents override what was created by parsing the document.
why: Indexing-side document sections overriding parsed content.

summary: Records the compression type applied to a repository section or attachment.
why: Utility option type for repository attachments.

summary: Records title sizing data used in Muppet: maximum title length in 'deciems' and number of title lines.
why: Title display length limits used in Muppet snippets.

summary: Stores how many distinct toolbar visitors a page had in the past day (VisitorsPastDay), present only if the number is reasonably large. Docs warn not to use it live without permission and say it exists only in the freshdocs pipeline.
why: Per-document visitor count signal in the freshdocs pipeline.

summary: Stores Google Flights airline configuration: IATA/ICAO codes, names, URLs, alliance, contact info, popularity and green-fares info.
Stores one airline contact entry (a type and its data, typically a phone number) for Google Flights.
Groups airline contact entries by country code for Google Flights.
Stores green-fares details for an airline in Google Flights: bonus miles program, quantity and type, and contribution framing.
Groups airline contact entries by language locale for Google Flights.
Stores one localized text value (language and text) in a Google Flights name catalog.
Stores a list of localized name entries used for airline names and URLs in Google Flights.
Stores client-specific data (service client ID, delegated project name, client labels) that Trawler/Harpoon clients attach to a fetch and that is kept in the Trawler fetch logs.
why: Crawler client bookkeeping, no page signal.

summary: Stores client-specified key/value labels used to annotate individual fetch requests and replies, so statistics can be sliced by label in the Nexus UI.
why: Crawler client labeling, no page signal.

summary: Holds a list of values in the deprecated map-style form of Trawler client labels.
Stores a parsed HTTP Content-Range header (start position, end position, total length) from a fetch.
why: Crawl fetch metadata for partial downloads.

summary: Records timestamps in milliseconds for a fetched page: original crawl time, time last checked and found unchanged, and reuse time. Filled in each redirect hop.
Records notable events during a URL fetch (such as fetch start or URL rejected), with message, occurrence count and timestamps, written to Trawler binary logs.
Stores a fetched body (content, compression type, uncompressed size hint).

Documents the metadata for a Trawler fetch reply: status, redirects, crawl times, robots info, HTTP version, SSL info, IPs, download timing and policy labels such as spam or roboted. It is the output interface from Multiverse/Trawler.
why: Core crawl fetch record including robots, redirects, status.

summary: Stores deprecated crawl dates (original crawl date, last-unchanged date, reuse date) for a fetch; docs say to use CrawlTimes instead.
Records the status, file path and events of delivering fetched content to a client's storage or via Goops.
Records time intervals the fetcher spent in connect, SSL, server response and transfer states for a fetch, plus overhead and control-flow stats.
Records client-side state timing for a fetch, such as waiting on a private content cache lookup.
Records microsecond waits in each fetcher state (DNS, scheduling, robots, compression, cache, credentials), populated only when state stats are requested.
Stores a single HTTP header as a key and value pair.
Stores chunk-level data for streamed fetches of large files: body location, chunk number, content range, ETag, fetch ID and whether it is the final response.
Stores protocol-specific response data for a fetch: response code, content type, truncation cutoff size and untruncated size.
why: Records HTTP status, content type and truncation of fetched pages.

summary: Documents each redirect hop of a fetch: target URL, response code, redirect type, meta-refresh time, robots and noindex info per hop, headers, crawl times and SSL data.
why: Redirect chain records with per-hop robots and noindex info.

summary: Stores WebIO, the 2023 hostload model that measures occupancy of one outgoing fetch connection for one minute, and its percentage tier.
Stores the outcome of a fetch as a State (such as crawled, roboted, error) and a Reason giving further detail.
why: Crawl outcome status of fetched URLs.

summary: Describes the scheduling host bucket a URL was in: connection limits, load, capacity and usage in QPS, minimum delay between requests and per-list data. Docs say to talk to the Trawler team before using it.
Describes one scheduling list in a host bucket: queue size, active fetches, whether the client may crawl now, request type and partner capacity.
Records cloud region and virtual network ID for VPC fetches tracked for logging.
Stores Multiverse client information for a fetch: topic ID and name, crawl policy ID and name, Hyperdrive app and table names, traffic type.
Stores information about the original client that started a fetch request: cell, IP, RPC type and username.
Stores a policy label Trawler can add to a fetch reply, such as 'spam' for listed spammer IPs or 'roboted:googlebot', with extra data like the robots info.
why: Policy labels like spam and roboted on fetch replies.

summary: Stores the result of HTTPS certificate validation for a fetch: certificate chain, validation errors, OCSP response, SCT list, ALPN protocol and TLS protocol/cipher details.
why: HTTPS certificate data recorded when crawling pages.

summary: Records the source and destination IP addresses and ports of a fetch connection.
Stores throttle settings for a fetch client: whether bandwidth throttling applies and the maximum allowed requests per second to a fetcher.

Stores logging-only data added to a fetch reply but never sent to clients: server signature, user agent sent, HSTS header, cache hit info, Google-Extended robots status, proxy, region, CDN provider and similar internal tracking.
why: Crawl logging including user agent, robots and CDN data.

summary: Records support for an interpretation in the Universal Search knowledge packer: result docid, URL, rank, a 0-to-1 score, estimated naviness, source and provenance.
why: Universal search packing support data for result interpretations.

summary: Records where a result support came from: provider name, entity group type for entity support, and a deprecated from-answer flag.
why: Provenance label for universal search result support.

summary: Stores sparse URL poisoning information: numSpamSiblings plus the crawl, unchanged and reuse timestamps and the URL for debugging. If numSpamSiblings is not populated, the other fields are not either.
why: Sparse spam-sibling count attached to a URL.

summary: Documents the wire format of a Status object: canonical code, numeric code, space, message and an attached message set.
Stores the trusted genome entities of a Google Play app (document type ANDROID_APP): policy, test codes and trusted genome hierarchies.
Stores a Google Play trusted genome entity: id, localized title, score, hierarchy level, category ID, query text and whether it is shown to users.
Groups Google Play trusted genome entities that have a parent-child relationship in a taxonomy (for example Action, Platformer, Endless Runner), with hierarchy type and source.
Stores policy information for Google Play trusted genome entries: policy types, target regions and a localized region override text.
Stores a localized region name and its knowledge graph mid for a Google Play trusted genome policy.
Stores ambisonic audio metadata for a video: channel map, channel ordering, normalization, number of channels, order, type, version and non-diegetic stereo flag.
Stores access control for a video in Venom: owner, readers and writers, written as mdb group or user names.
Undocumented. Described only as ingredient-level settings defined by clients in Venom, with no attributes listed (inferred from field names: none).
Records whether a Venom video ingredient reached an objective: objective, outcome and an optional debug reason.
Stores the unique identifier of a video in Venom: an id (max 32 bytes, currently parseable as a YouTube ID) and a namespace.
Stores properties of a video's audio stream: bitrate, channels, codec ID, content type, language, length, loudness, sample rate and stream index.
Stores generic clip information as a key string and a value string.
Stores a flag for whether a video has closed captions.

Stores features that apply to all video anchor types: similarity scores against ASR text, description and title, Dolphin and MUM descriptiveness and usefulness scores, a retention score, label embedding and timing data.
why: Video anchor scoring features for video content search.

summary: Maps segments of a long video anchor label to start times, with ASR confidence, sentence-start flag and character index range.
Stores properties of the thumbnail shown for a video anchor: serving docid, missing flag, serving metadata, thumbnail info and frame timestamp.
Stores thumbnail details for a video anchor: color entropy, image data for SafeSearch, an unsafe flag, a Starburst v4 embedding and raw bytes.
Stores summaries of Dolphin and MUM descriptiveness and usefulness scores across the anchors in a video anchor set.
Stores set-level thumbnail info for video anchors: whether any thumbnails or Starburst embeddings are missing and a thumbnail diversity score.
Stores a product aspect for video content search, from SAFT annotation or a fallback aspect.
Stores token-level ASR caption information for a video: text, confidence, start time and duration.
Stores the candidate and reference text used for Bleurt inference on video anchors.
Stores features and debug info for individual entity anchors in videos: ASR mention text and timing, mention counts, entity connectedness, topicality, broadness and whether the entity is a product.
Stores features for clusters of caption entity video anchors: aggregate score, cluster size, hypernym and its salience, mention counts and group cohesion.
Stores how many documents and mentions an entity has across the video corpus, with totals for the corpus.
Stores transcript-level data for a video, from ASR or closed captions: ASR token captions and a SAFT document.
Stores timing and text for a video anchor label: aligned time, label text, surrounding context text, aligned OCR texts and text similarity features.
why: Video anchor label timing and text.

summary: Stores features for caption span anchors in videos: Dolphin features and scores, embedding distances to other anchors, gaps to neighbor anchors, token ranges and ASR confidence stats.
Stores a summary of Dolphin scores over a set of caption span anchors.
Stores a root comment and its replies for a set of video comment anchors.
Stores one YouTube comment: ID, like count, text (display and original), published and updated times, or an internal MiniStanza representation.
Stores features for description-based video anchors: entity text coverage, whether the anchor appears in ASR, whether it is a training positive, and time distance to the ASR sentence.
Stores counts and fraction of description anchors matched to ASR captions and the number of unique mids matched.
Stores metadata about a video anchor taken from a description span: token counts, ratio, and Dolphin span scores.
Stores the Dolphin callout score from one individual model of an ensemble, with the model name.
Stores the inputs used to build a Dolphin example for a video anchor: query, alt query, answer, title, URL and timestamp.
Stores configuration for Dolphin scoring in video content search: model name and path, inference method, batch size, output keys, RPC settings and ensemble model names.
Stores entity annotations for an anchor label or query text: Webref mid, category, confidence and a restricted-category flag.
Stores a collection ID and a label for a group of video anchors.
Stores frame-level similarity between a topic and Starburst features over an interval of video frames, with start and end timestamps.
Stores a frame-level Starburst dense feature vector with its version and timestamp.
Stores passage, target and prediction results from generative models used in video content search.
Stores topic predictions (beam search outputs) from the prediction service, the model name and a ground truth topic when available.
Undocumented. Described only as anchor-level metadata about instruction anchors with no attributes listed (inferred from field names: none).
Stores match info linking instruction passage anchors to description anchors, ASR n-grams and instruction steps extracted from web docs.

Stores anchor-level metadata for list-style video description anchors: babel match info, description span info, list item index, match scores against ASR snippets, a pretrigger score and title similarity.
Stores cluster-level metadata about list anchors in a video: counts of description list items and matched anchors, ratios, span token stats and score summaries.
Stores metadata on description anchors used as list items to build training data: annotated time, time gap to ASR match, edit distance and matched texts.
Stores cluster-level summaries (edit distance, time gap stats, anchor count) for description anchors used to build list-anchor training data.
Stores a list of text match infos plus the matching method used (such as babel, nlp, neon or phonetic).
Stores median, mean, standard deviation, min, max and sum of a feature value.
why: Generic stats helper used in video anchor features.

summary: Stores multimodal features for one generated video topic: text, start and end time, frame similarity intervals, generative predictions and navboost anchor features.

Stores multimodal features for a generated topic used to build training data: max frame similarity, normalized topic, QBST overlap, Rankembed neighbor features, SAFT entity info and a Starburst topic vector.
Stores a SAFT named entity (type name and text) found in a video anchor label.
Stores features for video queries generated from document navboost data with timed anchors: the anchor text, the navboost query and how it was constructed.
why: Video queries built from navboost and anchors.

summary: Stores OCR text recognized in a video frame with its appearance time and position, font and color details.
Stores how closely an OCR text matches nearby ASR speech: character edit distances, word overlap counts and percentages, and a pretrigger score.
Stores a word-overlap score between OCR and ASR for anchors in a cluster, and a normalized version.
why: Video OCR-ASR overlap for a cluster.

summary: Stores metadata joining description anchors with OCR data for training: edit distance, ratio, matched texts and matched frame time.
Stores set-level edit distance stats (max, max ratio, median) for description anchors joined with OCR text.
Stores video-level OCR info: average text area ratio, duration, detected languages, and shot cluster and frame counts.
Stores features for a cluster of on-screen text anchors: size and ratio, duration, position, text length and height stats, counting-number ratio and OCR-ASR overlap.
Stores features of a piece of on-screen text: position and box ratios, font size, colors, rotation, languages, counting numbers, shot boundaries and OCR-ASR overlap.
why: Video on-screen text styling and position.

summary: Stores the fraction of an original query's salient terms covered by the anchor text and by the video's top navboost query.
Stores features for question-and-answer video anchors: question, ASR answer, time span, Dolphin and Descartes scores, title similarity, NavBoost query counts and WebRef topicality.
why: Video Q and A anchor features.

summary: Stores debug info for Q and A video anchors: Descartes model version and threshold, Dolphin config, ensemble model path and threshold, topicality and clustering thresholds.
why: Video Q and A anchor debug config.

summary: Stores Rankembed similarity between a neighbor query and the video anchor, the video's top navboost query and the original query candidate.
Stores SAFT named entity info for a topic: canonical name, salience, type, mention text and type, mid and original text.
Stores features for pro and con shopping opinion anchors in videos: anchor label, sentiment, product aspect, MUM, Grampus and Lumin scores, and ASR snippet scores.
Stores how a token sequence in ASR matched reference text such as a description anchor or an instruction step from a web document: scores, timestamps and positions.
Stores the ASR passage and video title used as inputs to the Dolphin span model.
Stores Dolphin span model output: span candidates and token-score pairs for a passage.
Stores a span candidate from the Dolphin span model: text, start time, source passage and summaries of token scores and ASR confidence.
Stores a token with its text, start time, ASR confidence, sentence-start flag and a score correlated with being part of a span candidate.
Stores features for sports key moments anchor sets: the prefilter classification label (such as basketball) and the TensorFlow model version.
Stores how an anchor label matched ASR text: match score, matched text and position, timestamps, time gap from the predicted time and description item index.
Stores token overlap between hypothesis and reference text: scoring method, similarity score, exact match counts and percent, and word alignment.
Stores a token-by-token mapping between hypothesis text and reference text, with indices and a perfect-match flag.
Stores token-level timing for ASR spans: text, start, duration and a 0-to-1 timestamp confidence.
Stores video-level info for online pipeline use: the skip-to-time pattern and start offset input name as defined by schema.org SeekToAction.
Stores a video anchor: label, time, duration, destination URL, thumbnail, mid, named entities, confidence and precision scores, safety flags and filter reasons.
Stores aggregated human rating scores for video anchors (average bookmark usefulness and description quality) with Furball URLs, used in training pipelines.

Stores scoring and debugging information for a single video anchor (a labeled moment in a video), including features per anchor type, filter reasons, a label embedding and a Safe Search output. Sits in the video anchors pipeline.
why: Video anchor debugging data; not web-page ranking.

summary: Records a video anchor label before cleaning, with a description of the transformation and the source label, kept in chronological order.
why: Video anchor label history; no web-page signal.

summary: Stores set-level human rating scores for a video anchor set: average description quality and average navigation usefulness, used in training.
why: Human rating data for video anchors.

summary: Top-level container for one video's anchor data: its actions, list of anchors by type, video info and video scoring info.
Holds one set of video text anchors of a given type, with a set quality score, predicted table-of-contents usefulness, filter reasons, thumbnail settings and intro info.
why: Video chapter/anchor data, not web-page signal.

summary: Stores set-level scoring and debugging features for video anchors across anchor types (caption, comment, description, list, OCR, Q&A, sports moments), plus human ratings.
Stores video-level features shared by all anchor types: anchor count, caption info and the names of the models used for embeddings and scoring.
Stores video-level features for queries generated from a video: filter reasons, passage counts, title entity annotations and a count of restricted-category queries.

Holds metadata and signals for one video page, mostly for offline debugging: title, description, language, NSR, Craps click data, salient terms, WebRef entities and verticals. The docs say never to populate it into serving.
why: Offline video debug record that references NSR and click data.

summary: Records whether a video has a skippable introduction and its start and end timestamps.
Stores video-level Starburst frame vectors, sorted by timestamp, used for generated multimodal topics.
Stores video-level scoring info for anchors: common features, OCR features, Safe Search output on the title, version, generated-query and multimodal topic features.
Stores Starburst visual tokens and feature vectors, with a version string, for video frames.

Stores inline playback details for the video attachment of the web search index: expiry time, analytics ID, country allow/deny lists, transcodes, VAST ad tag and video IDs. Used for the interest feed.
why: Video attachment playback config, no signal.

summary: Documents Dolby Vision decoder configuration for a video stream: profile, level, version, layer flags and FourCC tag.
Records color primaries, transfer characteristics, matrix coefficients and range for a video signal.
Records maximum content and frame-average light levels for a video, as hints for tone mapping.
Records frame packing arrangement for stereo video: type, interpretation, grid offsets and quincunx sampling.
Records HDR10+ statistics over video frames, such as application version and targeted display luminance.
Records mastering display color volume: primaries, white point, and min/max luminance.
Stores an x/y color coordinate in the CIE1931 color space.
Stores spherical (360/VR) video metadata: projection type, stereo mode, stitching info, pose, field-of-view bounds and frame dimensions.
Stores cropping coordinates in pixels (left, top, width, height) for a spherical video.
Specifies cubemap projection layout and per-face padding for spherical video.
Specifies equirectangular projection bounds cropped from each edge of the frame.
Stores start and end yaw and tilt angles describing a field-of-view range.
Specifies mesh projection data for spherical video: raw mesh content, mesh type and analyzed bounds.
Records heading, pitch and roll for the origin of a spherical projection.
Records heading, pitch and roll as integers for the initial view of a spherical video.
Records details of videos made with the YouTube app: app version, product type, asset IDs and logging IDs for dubbing.
Pairs a feature set name with a set of Legos annotations produced by YouTube Discovery.
Holds a list of Legos annotation sets, each keyed by feature set name.
Describes a media file: container ID, file size, a high-level overview, and its audio and video streams.
Stores a privacy-safe overview of a media file: aspect ratio, resolution, orientation, frame rate, dynamic range, projection and per-stream overviews.
Describes an audio stream without personal data: channels, content type, language, loudness and rounded duration.
Describes data streams in a media file, such as camera motion metadata and OZO spatial audio, used to exclude clips.
Records whether a clip has geolocation data.
Undocumented beyond its purpose: marks timed text streams in a media file, with no attributes (inferred from field names and doc: used to exclude clips that have timed text).
Describes a video stream without personal data: codec, resolution, fps, dynamic range, rounded duration and whether closed captions exist.
Per-document video data holding core video signals and video frames from the media index.
Records which thumbnails and storyboards were generated for a video in the Viper pipeline (hqdefault, maxresdefault, WebP, storyboard parameters, blob refs).
Records the video stream info computed in the Viper pipeline, with read time, total VSI time and whether the file was partial.
Records per-output stats of video stream info computation: whether it was partial and how long it took.
Stores a fraction as numerator and denominator integers.
Records SEI message counts per payload type and their cumulative size for H.264/H.265 video streams.
Stores loudness measurements of audio, using ITU-R BS.1770 and ReplayGain-based perceptual loudness.
Describes one video frame saved as an image file: filename, size and millisecond offset.
Holds a list of video frames each saved as an image file.
Stores a score computed for a video thumbnail, with dense and sparse features, model version, thumbnail set and whether it was manually assigned.
Stores automatic language identification results for a video's speech: sorted language scores and the detected speech class.
Stores a language code and a 0-1 relative confidence for one candidate language of video speech.
Counts ITU-T T.35 registered user-data messages in a video by country and provider code.
Records unregistered user data in a video identified by UUID, with a count and optional payload.
Stores metadata extracted from a video file: artist, author, copyright, camera make/model, keywords, software, title and optional geolocation.
Stores geolocation from video metadata as latitude and longitude times 10^7 and altitude in centimeters.
Describes one video stream: bitrate, codec ID, fps, size, length and stream index.
Large record of technical video stream info for a file (VSI): audio/video streams, codecs, durations, bitrates, container details, parse status and quality flags.
Describes one audio stream in a file: codec, bitrate, channels, sample rate, language, timestamps and ambisonics metadata.
Describes a data stream in a media file (such as camera motion metadata): codec info and stream index.
Holds extra stream metadata: attached 3D look-up tables and frame packing arrangement.
Holds a list of attached 3D look-up tables.
Describes a 3D look-up table: encoded data, original file name and size per dimension.
Describes a timed text stream separate from audio and video: codec, metadata and stream index.
Describes one video stream in detail: fps stats, codec, color info, HDR and Dolby Vision data, GOP sizes, rotation, SEI messages and spherical info.
Stores clean aperture width, height and offsets for a video stream.
Stores min, mean and max statistics for a video stream measurement.
Stores one predicted smart reply for a YouTube comment: reply text, model score and diversification and bias settings.
Holds the ordered list of smart reply suggestions for a YouTube comment and the identifier of the list they came from.
Stores YouTube comment engagement counts: impressions, upvotes, downvotes, teaser impressions and clicks over a measure window.

Per-document info returned for web search DocInfo requests: robots flags (noindex, nosnippet, noarchive), meta description quality flags, language, crawl time, SafeSearch and porn classifications, SSL status, NSR site chunk, and a QScore quality value, plus image fields.
why: Per-doc quality score, robots flags and meta description flags.

summary: Stores a related image's doc ID and thumbnail type and size, returned with a document.
Stores a thumbnail's type, width, height and expiration timestamp.
Stores a meta tag's name and content, returned with snippet responses.
why: Meta tag data returned in snippet responses.

summary: Holds per-image signals for sub-image docs in web results, consumed by the web image boost twiddler: EQ* and TQ* quality scores, salience, estimated relevance, document trust, Safe Search signals and thumbnail sizes.
why: Image-in-web-result signals, scoped to image boosting.

summary: Per-document snippet response for a web search request: chosen body tidbits, title rendering and truncation, meta tags, byline date, site display name, preview restrictions, login-page flag and snippet features for analysis.
why: Snippet and title generation structure for web results.

summary: Stores an encoded bitmap and its size, used to mark query-term matches in snippet fragments.
Stores a versioned list of predicted languages for a video watch page, with scores and whether speech signals were used.
Stores one predicted language and its score from the WatchPage Language model.
Stores watch page language results: the V1 predicted language and a list of versioned predictions, first being the latest production version.
Documents that a Live Result feed exists for a document and records a boost level between 0 and 1 plus the hot-times range in which the page's rank may be boosted.
why: Documented time-bound rank boost attached to web documents.

summary: Attaches a Live Result provider to a web document, with provider ID, a use-case tag and a fingerprint of that tag.
why: Links web documents to Live Result feeds.

summary: Container attached to web documents that records Live Result rank-boost data and provider attachments used to decide which Live Result to trigger.
why: Doc attachment holding live-result boost data.

summary: Stores start and end Unix times for the window in which a Live Result is considered hot.
Wraps an HTML string that is asserted safe; the docs warn it should not be accepted from untrusted sources.
Stores a name and value pair of metadata from a wireless transcoder fetch.
Records which fetcher satisfied a fetch request, with optional fetcher-specific detail, in the wireless transcoder.
Records purchase details for a YouTube comment posted via Super Thanks: currency, price, item and transaction IDs, and experiment version.
Summarizes a YouTube comment's enforcement state: held, moderated, rejected, blocked-word moderation and demotion severity, used to shape the viewer experience.
Records a privileged user's moderation decision on a YouTube comment, with status and reject type.
Records one moderated restriction on a YouTube comment: issuer, reason, status, timestamps and, for live chat, auto-moderation HOLD enforcement.
Records whether a live chat auto-moderation HOLD decision was enforced, with enforcement depending on write QPS.
Identifies who issued a YouTube comment restriction, with channel owner or moderator details when relevant.
Stores the external channel ID of a moderator who issued a comment restriction, for audit logs.
Stores the external channel ID of a channel owner who issued a comment restriction, for audit logs.
Stores the reason a YouTube comment restriction was issued.
Simplified record of a YouTube comment with its text, author, likes, replies, language, quality and spam scores, sentiment, embeddings, moderation status and smart replies.
Stores a text embedding vector for a YouTube comment.
Stores a predicted probability that a YouTube comment is flagged by users, with the model version.
Stores sentiment extracted from content: polarity, magnitude, average score and per-entity sentiment annotations.
Stores sentiment aggregated across all mentions of one entity: name, MID, polarity, magnitude, score and per-mention annotations.
Stores sentiment for one entity mention: token span, polarity, magnitude and score.
Records one Legos annotation of a document by a Knowledge Graph entity, typed as format, present, semantic or taxonomic relationship.
Holds the collection of Legos annotations for a document, at most one per entity and relationship type.
Identifies a Knowledge Graph entity in Legos by its primary KG ID; the debug name field is marked do not use.
Records a format annotation confidence score, in the 0-1 range, saying what format a video is.
Records a confidence score and optional contexts for an entity present in a video.
Records a semantic Legos annotation: what a video is about and why to watch it, with a confidence score and contexts.
Records extra context on how an entity relates to a document: a type and a subject entity.
Records a taxonomy annotation score in the 0-1 range and whether it is redundant given child-node annotations.
